pageNotes.note: The admin page loads cleanly (no console errors, no layout breakage) and every documented section is present: Agent Engine, Claude Code, Allowed Users, Create invite link, Google Services, Telegram, Secrets, Notifications, Tailscale. BUT the browse session authenticates with BBX_BROWSE_API_KEY, which passes the box auth wall without producing an owner identity (server-box-scope.ts returns early on verifyBrowseKey; resolveRequestIdentity never runs, so ctx.isOwner is false). Result: Agent Engine, Claude Code, Allowed Users, Invite, Google Services and Telegram all render 'Owner access required' in place of their data, and Secrets renders 'secrets management requires an authenticated owner session...'. There is no way for this agent to obtain an owner session (the credential store is ~/.bbx-auth.json, global and off-limits), so every owner-gated story below is inconclusive rather than failed. Other observations: (1) the Secrets section renders the SAME 'requires an authenticated owner session' alert TWICE (once for boxStatus, once for machineView) — duplicated error text, worth tidying. (2) 'Add a new secret' click opens nothing at all, with no feedback — the toggle appears inert in the error state. (3) Tooling, not the app: `bin/browse open /admin` (relative-path rewrite) exits 1 with zero output; only the full router URL works. bin/browse also intermittently returns 'agent-browser exited -1: (no output)' under parallel-agent load, and `bin/browse click @ref` on the 'Create invite link' submit button dispatched no network request (a DOM .click() via eval did). Used `--session adminchk` to stop other concurrent agents navigating this browser out from under the checks.

1) /card/<dir>.attach returns 'Error loading … Failed to load: 404 Not Found' — the card-page directory view works for ordinary directories (/card/box/inbox renders the directory renderer) but 404s for an attach directory (/card/box/inbox/scan-20260429T0322-dbe99514.attach). The same path under /browse lists fine, so it is the card route's directory load that fails. 2) On a cold browser profile the browse sidebar sat on 'Loading...' indefinitely (screenshot .claude/screenshots/0027-iso-browse-root.png); a reload resolved it. Reproduced a few times during the session while several agents were hitting the same box server, so it may be contention rather than a pure bug, but the pane offers no error/retry — it just stays 'Loading...'. 3) Card-body links point at /<box>/views/<path> hrefs (e.g. /user-stories-refresh/test1/views/box/examples/people/Charles_Babbage.person.card) even though following one lands on /browse/<path>. 4) Console on /browse is clean apart from Vite HMR fallback noise. 5) Environment: bin/browse is extremely flaky when several agents share the worktree — its pre-run reaper kills other agents' agent-browser daemons, so commands die with 'agent-browser exited -1', and pages were repeatedly re-mounted mid-interaction. I worked around it with an isolated socket dir/profile plus retries; a few verdicts needed several attempts.

No JS page errors and no console errors beyond Vite/React-devtools dev noise. Visible problems found while driving the page: (1) IMAGE ROTATION IS WRONG — box/inbox/scan-20260429T0246-6c66f791.attach/photo-001.image.card and box/inbox/scan-20260429T0320-15d9ae2a.attach/photo-001.image.card both carry rotation: "270"; the source JPEG is a quarter-turn off (heads to the left) but the rendered result is upside-down, the rotated overflows the detail panel horizontally (it starts left of the panel edge and is clipped by the viewport), and the purple subject-bbox rectangle no longer lines up with the photo. Non-rotated image cards render correctly. (2) FAILED IMAGES SHOW NO PLACEHOLDER — an in-box image URL that 404s renders the browser's native broken-image glyph; the app's 'Failed to load' ErrorPlaceholder never appears (verified via DOM: no element with role=img/aria-label 'Failed to load', innerText has no 'Failed to load'). Repro: /browse/box/inbox/scan-20260429T0246-6c66f791.attach/attach/photo-001.jpg. (3) todo-view card 'The Plate' reports 2 cards it can't read: 'no registered schema for card type "calendar-review-job"' and 'no registered schema for card type "todo-list"' — the box holds cards of types the app has no schema for. (4) Recipe yield does not scale — at 0.5x/2x the ingredients scale correctly but the YIELD line still reads '6 servings' (base 6). (5) Extfile cards (store/reviews/*.extfile.card) show 'Couldn't load the file. It may be missing, outside the allowed roots...' because they point at an absolute path outside this worktree; the commentary block above still renders. (6) Tooling note: bin/browse in this worktree intermittently exits -1 with no output on open/snapshot/screenshot (page-ready wait); --no-wait plus retries works around it.

No page errors (bin/browse errors is empty); console holds only vite HMR/React-DevTools info and [chatfsm] debug lines. /browse renders the tree (box 791 items, config 24, store 46, etc.) with a 'Select a file to view details' right pane. Card pages render cleanly. Two observations not covered by a story: (1) a `ref:` that is the whole field value (e.g. course.concept-map) renders as a clickable control, but a `ref:` nested inside a list-of-objects (question card `context: [{ref, text}]`) renders as plain StaticText with no link — refs are only linkified at the scalar-field position; (2) clicking a ref control opens the target card in a modal preview dialog rather than navigating to its /card/... URL. Also: the chat husk cards in this box carry only `session` (+ sometimes `title`) — none has a `contains` field, so the 'what the conversation contained' half of fe-chat-r1-10 has no data to render here.

The browser profile is shared per-worktree and another agent was driving the same session during this check, so several navigations were stomped (landed on /browse/... or /dev/composer-states). Verdicts below rest on the runs that were clean. Real issues seen: (1) console error on every capture-mode open -- '[capture] Failed to load resumable sessions: ResumableCaptureListError: List resumable capture sessions failed (capture-api.ts:100)', which also lights up the nav's 'Open debug log (1 error)' badge; the capture panel otherwise renders. (2) The redirect writes the search param JSON-quoted, so the address bar reads chat?capture=%221%22 (i.e. capture="1") rather than capture=1 -- ugly for a shortcut URL a person might copy, though the app parses it. (3) On some loads the final URL was chat?session=<id> with the capture param gone and no capture panel; ChatPage's session redirect appears able to drop the param, but I could not separate this from the cross-agent navigation interference. (4) The root box-selection page (http://localhost:3210/user-stories-refresh/) redirects to /auth/login, so the box tiles were not reachable. (5) Chat composer had a leftover draft ('Please reply with exactly: pong') from another session -- not mine.

Box had zero chat sessions at start (content/.beebox/chat-session-history.json was {"sessions":[],"migrated":true} and no SDK transcripts for this worktree clone), so all history had to be created by sending short messages. Observed issues: (1) A hidden Capture sheet is always present in the chat page's a11y tree (headings 'Capture', 'Start camera', 'Exit capture' etc.), and its session bootstrap fails — the toolbar shows 'Open debug log (1 error)' with 'Session creation failed: Create session failed: 401' on a plain /chat load; the Exit capture / x buttons did not remove it from the tree. (2) Bare keystrokes when the composer is not focused are swallowed by global hotkeys and navigate the app (typing a sentence with the composer unfocused jumped to Browse pages and opened the capture sheet) — worth knowing, possibly by design. (3) 'Run /compact' from Advanced posts a visible '/compact' user bubble and the agent answered it as ordinary prose; no 'Context compacted' marker was rendered. (4) The shared browse daemon is driven by other concurrent sessions in this worktree — I had to use `bin/browse --session chat1` for an isolated browser.

1) Place chip goes stale on client-side navigation: opening a landmark-scoped chat via the Place menu or the card page's 'New' chat button leaves the header chip reading 'Place: Chat' with no 'Here:' chip, even though the URL carries contextDir=store/courses/Acids_Bases.attach. A full page load of the same URL renders 'Place: Acids & Bases' + 'Here: Acids_Bases.attach' correctly. Reproduced three times. Everything in the landmark menu (directory, curated links, Recent files) is therefore unreachable until you reload. 2) Bulk upload fails auth in dev: Add > 'Upload files...' > add two small .txt files produced 'Create bulk batch failed: Not authenticated' and both rows Failed / 'Could not register with server'. The single-file composer attach path on the same page/cookie worked fine, so the bulk endpoint appears not to accept the browse-key cookie the rest of the app authenticates with. 3) Composer draft is not scoped per chat: a draft left in one session ('[selection1] [image1] draft survives?') reappeared verbatim in a brand-new session started from a card, and typing inserted my text into the middle of it. 4) In the Recent-files card preview, 'Open as full page (new tab)' links to /test1/browse/... with no worktree prefix — a 404 under the dev router (probably fine in prod where the box is at the root). 5) Operational note, not an app bug: bin/browse's default session is shared across worktree sessions, so another agent's clicks drove my tab (page jumped to /browse/config/schedules and about:blank) until I moved to --session chat2. The daemon also intermittently returns empty output; retries were needed throughout.

No page errors and no failed-to-load regions; console carries only vite HMR/React-DevTools noise. Two observations worth flagging: (1) the HeaderStrip h1 renders the box's content-directory basename — literally the word 'content' — with the absolute filesystem path beneath it, so the header reads 'content' rather than the box name 'test1' (the nav's Place chip is what actually says test1). (2) The app nav bar has no counts/badges at all: it is a Place dropdown (landmarks + Dashboard/Browse/History/Inventory) plus a User avatar menu; nothing surfaces pending questions or on-plate todos from the nav on any page, even though the dashboard body knows Questions=39 and Inbox=136. Also: SystemInfo shows version and created date but no deployed commit (no deploy-info.json in a local dev checkout), and every schedule shows Last Run 'never', so the scheduler tick log is empty and nothing exercises the tick-related UI. bin/browse needs dangerouslyDisableSandbox to launch Chromium here, and the default browse session is shared across concurrent agents — I ran in an isolated --session to avoid tab collisions.

Dev harness (route only exists in dev builds). It renders four sections: pending-bubble caption gallery, failed-upload banner faces, scripted capture-status transitions, delivered capture chips, plus a live CaptureOverlay mounted against an in-memory fake CaptureApi (create/finalize/cancel are log-only no-ops). Two real problems seen: (1) every time the overlay opens, the console logs '[capture] Failed to load resumable sessions: ResumableCaptureListError' — the harness fake CaptureApi (makeFakeApi in pages/dev/components/CaptureModeHarness.tsx) implements create/finalize/cancel/upload but not the resumable-session probe, so useCaptureResume falls through to a real network call that fails; the harness therefore can never show the resume dialog. (2) In the overlay, the red CaptureErrorBanner is drawn on top of the open Device settings panel and covers the 'Camera'/'Microphone' select labels (see screenshot) — the banner and the settings sheet occupy the same strip. Camera cannot actually start in this headless browser ('Camera access failed: Permission denied'), so camera-live affordances (flip/off, photo shutter) were not exercisable. No other console errors beyond expected fake-upload failures.

Page renders cleanly at 1280x900: a header line ('37 realizable combinations ... 8 filtered as impossible'), a labeled card per state, and an 'Impossible combinations (filtered)' section with per-row reasons. No page console errors (only vite HMR/debug/React-DevTools noise); one recurring vite info line: '[vite] Direct websocket connection fallback' on every load. The sibling dev routes also render: /dev/capture-mode (pending-capture bubble captions: preparing/transcribing/queued/still preparing 4 min/delivered/discarded) and /dev/speech (speech menu harness, mocked slow TTS, window.__speechTestLog, live state line). Harness state cards are static: clicking the lock button inside a gallery/isolated card does not change aria-pressed (expected for a state gallery, but worth knowing). Mobile-only states (keyboard row, recording row) render blank/desktop-composer unless the viewport is phone-width - the page says so. Tooling note: bin/browse's default session was being driven concurrently by another agent in this worktree (page kept jumping to /chat and to the login page); using an explicit --session fixed it. bin/browse open with a bare app path (/dev/composer-states) failed with 'agent-browser exited -1 (no output)'; the full URL worked, and the daemon intermittently returned that same empty error requiring retries.

The harness was initially broken end-to-end: every segment went to state 'failed' with console errors `[TTS] Playback error: TTS API error 500 {"error":"mock TTS fixture missing — run: pnpm tsx scripts/gen-tts-fixtures.ts"}`. Root cause is packaging, not a missing fixture: the fixtures ARE committed at beebox/src/webapp/test-fixtures/tts/{seg0,seg1,seg2}.mp3, but the box server runs the bundled build (beebox/dist/cli.mjs), where `const FIXTURE_DIR = join(import.meta.dirname, "test-fixtures", "tts")` (src/webapp/tts-mock.ts:21) resolves to beebox/dist/test-fixtures/tts — a directory the build never creates. The mp3s are not copied into dist by `tsc`, so the dev-only /dev/speech harness is unusable on any dist-run server. Worth filing. I worked around it locally by copying the three mp3s into the gitignored beebox/dist/test-fixtures/tts/ (left in place; it disappears on a clean build). Second gotcha for future checkers: browser autoplay policy means playback only starts from a real user gesture — a scripted .click() fails with NotAllowedError; use bin/browse click. Also note the menu's control row renders in DOM/a11y order Stop, Replay, Fast-forward, while the component doc comment describes Stop, Fast-forward, then Replay below the row — cosmetic ordering discrepancy only, all controls present. No other console errors or layout breakage on the page.

Two real defects found. (1) Deep-linking a commit outside the first loaded page silently shows the wrong commit: /history/8d65fe14 (138 commits back) keeps the hash in the URL but renders the NEWEST commit (993f5e8a) in the detail pane and highlights it in the sidebar — no 'not loaded' state, no error. Deep links to commits inside the loaded 50 work correctly. (2) The `path` filter only matches box-relative paths (e.g. `config/template-versions.json`), while every file path the UI itself displays in the diff panel is prefixed with `content/` (e.g. `content/config/template-versions.json`). Passing the displayed form renders the path chip plus 'No commits found' / '0 loaded' — silently empty rather than an error. Verified against the API: history.list with path `config/template-versions.json` returns commits; with `content/config/template-versions.json` returns []. No console errors on the page (only Vite HMR/React DevTools noise). Environment note: the shared agent-browser daemon for this worktree was very flaky (many `agent-browser exited -1` with no output, ~79 daemon processes from parallel sessions); every command needed retries. That is tooling, not the app.

Page renders cleanly; no console errors (only Vite HMR info/debug lines). One interaction quirk: `bin/browse click @eN` on the Area-view tabs reports success but does not change the selected tab; clicking the same button via JS (element.click()) works and the treemap re-renders. Could be a browse-harness click-coordinate issue rather than an app bug, but worth noting since the tabs are custom role=tab buttons with roving tabindex. 'Refresh scan' completes without error and re-renders the same figures.

Page renders cleanly, no page errors; console shows only vite HMR chatter. The test1 box has only two landmark cards (Box, Acids & Bases) and ZERO chat sessions (content/.beebox/chat-session-history.json is {"sessions":[],"migrated":true}), so every landmark shows 'No chats here yet.' + a New chat link. chat.byLandmark and chat.placeMenu both return problems: [] — no malformed landmark cards exist to exercise the warning paths. Also note: bin/browse in this worktree is flaky — roughly every other invocation exits -1 with no output and needs a retry; and the default session is shared, so concurrent page-checking agents in one worktree steal each other's tab (I had to use --session lm).

The served login page lives at the worktree prefix (/user-stories-refresh/auth/login), not under the box segment. Visiting /user-stories-refresh/test1/auth/login unauthenticated in a browser renders raw JSON: {"message":"Route GET:/test1/auth/login not found","error":"Not Found","statusCode":404} — a logged-out user who lands on a box-prefixed /auth/login deep link sees a 404 blob instead of a sign-in form (curl with Accept: text/html gets a 302 to the worktree-prefix login, so this depends on how the request is made). Password-reset routes: /auth/reset and /auth/password-reset are not routes (302 back to login); the real one is /auth/reset-password. Unrelated: opening the chat Capture panel in the browse-key session showed 'Session creation failed: Create session failed: 401'. Tooling: bin/browse/agent-browser was very flaky this run — frequent silent exits, page-ready timeouts, and snapshot refs renumbering between calls; several observations needed retries.

Page renders 39 pending question cards (2 confirm-type with Yes/No + optional Note, 37 text-type with Answer + Submit Answer + Dismiss). No console errors beyond normal Vite HMR chatter; no failed-to-load regions. Sections observed: INVALID (only after I planted a probe card), pending list, ARCHIVE. Minor UI inconsistency: pending entries render an h3 with the card name, but once a question is answered its archive entry drops the name heading and shows only prompt / answer / status badge. No filtering or pagination — all 39 pending questions render in one long column. Tooling note (not an app bug): `bin/browse click @eN` silently no-op'd on this page (button state unchanged, card untouched); I had to dispatch clicks via `bin/browse eval` DOM .click(). Also, the default browse session is shared with other agents in this worktree and kept navigating away mid-check — I used `--session qcheck` to isolate. Box mutations I made in the disposable worktree clone (~/src/box-worktrees/user-stories-refresh/test1), left in place as evidence: dismissed then answered scan-20260429T0322-dbe99514_unsure-008 (two auto-commits: 'Dismiss question:' / 'Answer question:'), which also produced box/jobs/2026-08-21T20-11-05-...question-followup.job.card. A temporary malformed card (zz-broken-probe.question.card) was created to exercise the invalid branch and has been deleted.

The settings page renders five sections: iOS Companion (Create QR + Paired devices), Password, Scan uploaders (Token name + Mint token + Uploaders + 'First-time setup on a new machine'), Google Calendar, Google Drive. MAJOR CAVEAT for this run: bin/browse's browse-key identity authenticates but is NOT the box owner — a direct tRPC probe of pairing.devices returned 403 FORBIDDEN 'Owner access required'. Every ownerProcedure-backed control (pairing ticket, device list/revoke, scan-token mint/list, calendar/drive config) therefore renders 'Owner access required' instead of its data, which is why several checks are inconclusive rather than failed. Second caveat: this box has no Google auth configured, so both Calendar and Drive sections sit permanently in their error state ('Google auth not configured. Run: bbx google-auth'). Observations worth flagging: (1) the Password section renders as a card with no heading at all, just the muted line 'Sign in to manage a local password.' — visually an empty panel; (2) the tRPC 403 error payload includes a full server stack trace with absolute filesystem paths in the response body visible to the browser; (3) one navigation to /admin transiently rendered a raw JSON body {"message":"Route GET:/test1/auth/login not found",...} in the page instead of a login screen — a reload loaded /admin fine, but an unauthenticated redirect path appears able to land on a raw JSON 404; (4) clicking 'Create QR' / 'Mint token' does surface the error inline next to the button (good), but the first click of Create QR via a ref click produced no visible change at all, so the error only appeared on a real click event. Tooling note: the agent-browser daemon in this worktree was flaky throughout (repeated 'agent-browser exited -1' with empty output, empty snapshots, --full screenshots silently not full-height); commands often had to be retried. That is a tooling problem, not an app one.
